description: The chart illustrates the performance of various models on different morphosyntactic tasks, with the categories listed on the horizontal axis in the order of gender, tag, number, and tense. The vertical axis is labeled "ellect" and has a linear scale ranging from 5 to 20, with tick labels at intervals of 5. Each category is represented by a set of box plots, with the boxes colored according to the legend, which indicates that the red color corresponds to XLM-B2. The box plots display the distribution of values for each model, with the median value marked by a line inside the box and the range of values indicated by the whiskers. The approximate median values for the categories are: gender (around 8-18), tag (around 11-14), number (around 12-16), and tense (around 13-14), with the XLM-B2 model generally having higher median values than the other models, particularly for the gender category, where it has a median value of around 18. The chart does not display any specific sorting or visual emphasis on particular bars or categories.
